question: After the package integrity repair and full import proof, should this production-derived sanitized baseline become the permanent test seeding source?
rationale: This changes the production-to-test data boundary and destructive import workflow, which automation cannot approve on policy grounds alone.

options.title: Land after repair and proof
options.body: Recompute validated artifact fingerprints, post the completed full baseline import evidence, and then use the sanitized snapshot workflow for the permanent test deployment.

options.title: Keep synthetic-only for now
options.body: Close or pause this branch and continue relying on synthetic fixtures until maintainers want production-derived test data.

recommendation.title: Land after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Recompute validated artifact fingerprints, post the completed full baseline import evidence, and then use the sanitized snapshot workflow for the permanent test deployment.
